notes.title: Round 99 Cloud Save
notes.content:
This is a quick but important one!

With the announcement of the Steam Deck, we have decided to add Cloud Saves to Round 99, a feature that's quickly becoming standard in gaming!

We have yet to do testing on Steam Deck, but Cloud Saves should make switching between platforms much easier, and more convenient for our players.

Check it out, and make sure to contact us if you have any issues!

notes.title: Round 99 - The Spin Update
notes.content:
Hello! Welcome to Round 99 Update 1.2, a smaller update than 1.1, but still one with crazy new changes!

 Upgrade Speed in shop
 Upgrade Jumping in shop
 Upgrade Time Control in shop
 Player-specific trails
 Physics calculations are now 10% faster!


...And more!

This is accompanying a permanent price decrease to $4.99 and a 20% discount, making the game $3.99 for an entire week!

Check out the trailer to see the new update in action!
[previewyoutube=TJqw_fGgx2o;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]











Purchase Round 99 on Steam, or get the Deluxe Edition for an updated OST and DLC!

notes.title: Round 99 Update 1.1.1
notes.content:
Hey!

So, we have another glorius patch.

It just fixes three tiny things

[olist]
Removed shop from the main menu due to being unnecessary and buggy (still available mid-level)
Improved cursor visibility
Improved mouse controls
[/olist]

Make sure to play as much Round 99 as you can! It's only the greatest game known to man!

notes.title: Round 99 - The 4-Star Update
notes.content:
Hello! Welcome to Round 99 Update 1.1, in which we have a lot of cool new stuff!

 4-Player Multiplayer
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/737903543088054366/808394706165563452/unknown.png?width=1247&height=702
 Players can now join at any point
 Multiplayer Options removed from the main menu
 Optimizations that speed up the game around 50%
 Bug fixes!
 Shop now works correctly, along with now being a feature that can be accessed mid-level
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/737903543088054366/808395136181469254/unknown.png?width=1249&height=702
 Better Difficulty Selection
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/737903543088054366/808395293543497728/unknown.png?width=1247&height=702
 Improved Tutorial
 More Sound Effects
 Remixed OST
 Steam Leaderboard Support
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/737903543088054366/808395541889155162/unknown.png
 Extra particle effects that occur when colliding with terrain
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/737903543088054366/808395947431428157/unknown.png?width=1440&height=690
 Swimming animation in Level 3
 Easier to navigate layout of Level 3.
https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/737903543088054366/808396655355363388/unknown.png?width=1440&height=692
 Transparent Mini-Map
 Slight weapon balancing


...And more!

There's also a 50% discount for all things Round 99, feel free to try the game out if you haven't given it a chance yet.

Check out the trailer to see the new update in action!
[previewyoutube=syZa10N5f7U;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]











Purchase Round 99 on Steam, or get the Deluxe Edition for an updated OST and DLC!

notes.title: Announcing Round 99 Deluxe Edition!
notes.content:
Announcing the Round 99 Deluxe Edition! 

During launch week you'll be able to purchase the game, the OST, and a DLC pack for $9.20!

That saves a whole$2.30!

Hope that sounds fun!

You can get the DLC, game, and soundtrack for a lower price than just the game and the DLC! How awesome!

This releases on the same day as the game, December 22.


After launch week, outside of sales, the game, DLC, and OST are worth $14. The Deluxe Edition will cost only $11.20
